clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, Alyissia calls young night elf warriors to defend their people. Conservator Ilthalaine carries her summons as the Kaldorei face changes across Teldrassil and beyond.

After you prove your basic survival skills against Shadowglen's restless wildlife, Conservator Ilthalaine gives you an inscribed sigil. The token formally marks your move into combat training. It carries a request from Alyissia, the warrior trainer at Aldrassil, asking you to dedicate your strength to defending your people.

Alyissia sets your training against a time of rapid change and danger. In only a few years, the night elves have raised the World Tree Teldrassil, seen a taint spread through forest beasts near and far, and reconnected with ancient lands once thought lost, including Feralas. The Kaldorei need capable defenders against these perils.

Alyissia prepares young Kaldorei for more than combat. She urges you not to judge outsiders who arrive on Teldrassil by their race. Some travelers may not act from pure generosity, but allies are vital to the Kaldorei's defense. As you take up the work of protecting your people, she asks you to offer them reasonable trust.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our warrior trainer, Alyissia. It seems Alyissia would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to her afterwards.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You made it. I'm so glad.

Much has happened over the last few years, friend: the creation of Teldrassil, the corruption of many of the forest creatures here and abroad, discovery of lands we thought lost to us like Feralas... So much, in so little time. But those are just some of the reasons we are here, the most important being to protect our kind from further evil.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Soon you will see others from different races in the boughs of our home--do not let it cause any prejudice within you. They are welcome. They will aid us when they can. Not all of them will be altruistic, but they should be granted some amount of trust.

But none of this matters now. Now we must focus on you, and how you can aid our people. I am here for that very purpose. I will train you in the ways of an adventurer as you become stronger. Return to me whenever you wish and I will do what I can to aid you.
